an9.94:1.1: rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya nava dhammā bhāvetabbā.
an9.94:1.3: paṭhamajjhānaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ catutthajjhānaṃ ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ saññāvedayitanirodho.
an9.94:1.4: rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya ime nava dhammā bhāvetabbā. 79
